mapper.select: SELECT trade_date, ROUND(SUM(hgt_yi),2) AS totalHgt, ROUND(SUM(sgt_yi),2) AS totalSgt, ROUND(SUM(hgt_yi + sgt_yi),2) AS totalNetInflow FROM signal_northbound WHERE trade_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY trade_date ORDER BY trade_date DESC
SELECT ROUND(AVG(hgt_yi),2) AS avgHgt, ROUND(AVG(sgt_yi),2) AS avgSgt, ROUND(AVG(hgt_yi + sgt_yi),2) AS avgNetInflow, COUNT(*) AS days FROM signal_northbound WHERE trade_date >= #{startDate}
